posts.headline: Eighteen editions of me doubting Thicks and the man just hung 530.16 points through four weeks — 4-0 and now I have to admit the ring might actually mean something.
posts.detail: The bar was 403.68 points a week ago; now it's 530.16 and still unbeaten, forcing the Busters Take to finally sweat a little on this one.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's 0-4 disaster is now the longest-running horror franchise in this league, and the 20-8 career mark is officially a museum piece.
posts.detail: A 1.5 average finish and 71.4% career win rate has produced exactly zero wins this season — Put it in Ra at 453.58 points is cosplaying as a bottom-feeder.

posts.headline: The Ultimate Light Skin is still winless at 0-4, and with 457.44 points scored but nothing to show for it, this is starting to look like a plague of locusts with good stats.
posts.detail: Eli's BIBLE OR THE BELT has a career mark of 13-14-1 and an average finish of 5.5, but 0-4 right now says the belt is winning this argument.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are 4-0 with a league-best 622.86 points and this league is STILL pretending triciagloston isn't the best team on the board.
posts.detail: A middling 6-7-1 career record didn't predict this, but 622.86 points through four weeks is the loudest number in Busters Anonymous right now.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way sits at 1-3 with 379.64 points, and Auntie Thomas's bottom-feeder pedigree — a 10 average finish — remains undefeated.
posts.detail: Six seasons' worth of history says this team finds the hard way every single time, and this year's 6-8 career trajectory is tracking right on schedule.
